meta.description: Infer cis-regulatory connections (peak-to-peak co-accessibility) from scATAC-seq using Cicero, ArchR getCoAccessibility, or SCENIC+, and map them to enhancer-gene candidates.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated values; enhancer column defect (COACC-002) is a coding error, and unsupported ranges are filed as P3 COACC-011

practice_boundaries.detail: Research analysis guidance; no clinical claims

methodological_ground.detail: Co-accessibility is explicitly framed as a hypothesis generator, not 3D contact; permutation control behaves as documented

code_usability.detail: The function ran to completion with a chr1-only genome_df and integer-format matrices load; CLI failure on pattern .mtx and the 25 min unmodified timeout are P1/P2 defects (COACC-001, COACC-003), not unrunnable code

functional_suitability.note: Sound method coverage and a working core pipeline, but the shipped CLI fails on the natural input, the enhancer-gene output is wrong, and routes beyond Cicero ship no code

reliability.note: No input validation; missing TSS BED silently skipped; unmodified function did not finish in 25 min; no seed

performance_context.note: SKILL.md is 68 lines with routed references; runtime cost of the full-genome default is not disclosed

agent_usability.note: Clear tool-selection tables and workflow; contradictory version guidance and non-existent parameter names reduce reliability

human_usability.note: Quick reference tables are readable; error recovery for the CLI, plotting, and dependency installs is thin

security.note: No credentials, no execution of user strings; unchecked file arguments only

maintainability.note: One script mixes CLI parsing, pipeline, and mapping; no tests; version claims drift between files

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger description and good progressive disclosure; composability weakened by routes without code and wrong install claim

key_strengths: Correct scientific framing: co-accessibility is a hypothesis generator, with explicit validation routes and an ABC/Hi-C decision table

ArchR and LinkPeaks routes ran with plausible outputs; Hi-C concordance snippet recovered planted truth
Lean SKILL.md with routed references and preserved MIT provenance

recommendations.title: CLI fails on binarized (pattern) .mtx input
recommendations.problem: The documented three-file CLI exits 1 because readMM returns a logical ngTMatrix that monocle3 rejects; the natural binary peak export is exactly this format.
recommendations.root_cause: The script passes readMM output straight to new_cell_data_set with no coercion or validation.
recommendations.fix: Coerce to a numeric dgCMatrix, set dimnames from the metadata, validate dimensions, and re-run the CLI on a pattern .mtx (COACC-001).

recommendations.title: enhancer-gene CSV column contains factor codes
recommendations.problem: Half of the enhancer values are integer factor codes, not peak names, and the table over-counts pairs (4,728 vs 3,083 correct).
recommendations.root_cause: c() of a factor Peak2 and a character Peak1 coerces the factor to integer codes.
recommendations.fix: Use as.character() on both anchors, de-duplicate unordered pairs, and assert every enhancer is an input peak name (COACC-002).

recommendations.title: Hard-coded all-chromosome genome_df; 25 min timeout
recommendations.problem: The unmodified function did not finish in 25 min on a chr1-only input; restricted to chr1 it took 8.5 min.
recommendations.root_cause: genome_df is fixed to all hg38 primary chromosomes regardless of the peak set.
recommendations.fix: Derive genome_df from the peak coordinates and document runtime scaling (COACC-003).

recommendations.title: Wrong cicero version and duplicated pair counts
recommendations.problem: 'Cicero 1.20+' resolves to the monocle-2 Bioconductor package, and every peak pair appears in both orientations so counts and concordance are doubled.
recommendations.root_cause: Version text was not checked against the monocle3-branch package; the symmetric output is not de-duplicated.
recommendations.fix: State GitHub cicero-release@monocle3 1.3.x and de-duplicate pairs before counting or plotting (COACC-004, COACC-005).

recommendations.title: Documentation contract errors: parameter, scores, plotting
recommendations.problem: genomic_distance_max does not exist, scores are described as 0-1 but go negative, and plotTracks(track) errors as written.
recommendations.root_cause: Reference snippets were not executed against the installed packages.
recommendations.fix: Use window/distance_constraint, document the -1 to 1 range and NA handling, give the plot a locus, and add a seed argument (COACC-006 to COACC-008).

recommendations.title: Enhancer-gene mapping inputs and unsupported claims
recommendations.problem: The TSS BED is unshipped and silently skipped, promoter-promoter pairs are labelled enhancers, and several quantitative claims and the SCENIC+ version/Docker statements are unsupported.
recommendations.root_cause: Undocumented input contract; claims carried over without citations or execution.
recommendations.fix: Document or generate the TSS BED, label promoter pairs, cite or soften the ranges, and pin SCENIC+ (COACC-009 to COACC-013).
